headline.title: 深入理解 ChatGPT Work：OpenAI 新一代智能工作产品的全景拆解
headline.summary: OpenAI 于 7 月 9 日发布 ChatGPT Work 后持续迭代。它实际上是两个产品：一个运行在云端，可通过 chatgpt.com 访问；另一个是本地版。该产品功能强大但极度令人困惑。作者梳理了其架构、使用场景与当前能力边界，帮助开发者理解如何在实际工作中运用。
headline.summary_en: OpenAI announced ChatGPT Work on July 9 and has iterated rapidly. It is actually two products: a cloud version accessed via chatgpt.com and a local one. Powerful yet confusing, this explainer unpacks the architecture, use cases, and current capabilities to help developers leverage it in real work.
